tooltipContent.body: Every open choice waiting on a client, across all your projects. Overdue decisions block procurement and put delivery dates at risk — clear them first.
Decisions you have sent that are still awaiting a client response. Counted while status is pending — resolved and draft decisions are excluded.
A pending decision whose response deadline has passed. Overdue items with a blocking status hold up the linked FF&E items in procurement.
The average days between sending a decision and the client responding, across resolved decisions. Lower means a faster-moving project.
The share of decisions resolved on or before their deadline this quarter. A high rate keeps ETAs and procurement on schedule.

emptyStateContent.heading: No open decisions
emptyStateContent.description: Nothing is waiting on a client right now. When a project needs a client to choose between options, send a decision from the project to track the response here.

emptyStateContent.heading: Nothing overdue
emptyStateContent.description: Every pending decision is still inside its response window. Keep an eye on the Due This Week tab so nothing slips past its deadline and blocks procurement.

emptyStateContent.heading: Nothing due this week
emptyStateContent.description: No pending decisions have a deadline in the next seven days. Decisions appear here as their response windows approach so you can chase them before they go overdue.

emptyStateContent.heading: No resolved decisions yet
emptyStateContent.description: Once a client responds to a decision it moves here as a record of what was chosen and when. Resolved decisions feed your average-response and resolution-rate metrics.
